title: Referred Pine+ members churned 7.1% in month 3, vs. 16.2% for paid social
subtitle: 8-week referral pilot readout: the pilot beat its sign-up target by 38% at $21 per sign-up, and we recommend rolling it out to all members in October.
summary: The 8-week Pine+ referral pilot brought in 4,140 sign-ups, 38% above its target of 3,000, at $21 per sign-up. Referred monthly-plan members churned 7.1% in month 3 against 16.2% for paid social. We recommend extending the referral credit to all members from Oct 6 with a 10% holdout.
key_findings: 4,140 referred sign-ups in 8 weeks, 38% above the target of 3,000.
Month-3 churn: 7.1% for referred members vs. 16.2% for paid social (p < 0.01).
Cost per sign-up: $21 for referral vs. $27 for search and $34 for paid social.
Recommendation: roll out to all Pine+ members from Oct 6 with a 10% holdout; revisit the $15 credit after 12 weeks.
